links.comparator_used: Leading LLMs handling elderly-specific risky prompts with their own built-in safety behavior (no dedicated safeguard classifier)
links.outcome: Detection of unsafe elderly-specific prompts / handling of contextual risks
links.effect: Leading LLMs mishandled elderly-specific contextual risks in over 50% of cases; the safeguards (fine-tuned Llama-Guard-3 and policy-enhanced gpt-oss-safeguard-20b) achieved up to 96.2% and 90.9% unsafe-prompt detection accuracy, respectively.
links.quote: We mitigate these failures with two safeguards: a fine-tuned Llama-Guard-3 and a policy-enhanced gpt-oss-safeguard-20b, achieving up to 96.2% and 90.9% unsafe-prompt detection accuracy, respectively.

design_hint: input safety classifier/guard model (prompt guardrails) for elderly-specific risks
